title: Fragor Prime
extract:
Fragor Prime is the Prime variant of the  Fragor, featuring higher damage, critical chance, critical multiplier, and status chance, at the expense of attack speed. It also has an initial combo count of 30. It was released alongside  Vauban Prime and  Akstiletto Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Impact damage.
Stance slot has  polarity, matches  Crushing Ruin stance.
Can equip the Brokk skin, which provides +5% attack speed, but -1s combo duration.
Advantages over other Melee   weapons (excluding modular weapons):

Has an initial Combo Count of 30 (2.0x initial heavy attack multiplier).

Acquisition

Vaultings
On March 14, 2018, it was announced that Fragor Prime, alongside  Vauban Prime and  Akstiletto Prime, would enter the Prime Vault and be retired from the reward tables on March 20, 2018. Any preexisting components or fully-built weapons will remain as is.
Fragor Prime resurfaced along with  Vauban Prime,  Akstiletto Prime,  Ash Prime,  Vectis Prime, and Carrier Prime from November 19th, 2019 to February 11th, 2020.

Tips
Thanks to its passive ability,  Blood Rush will always be active, guaranteeing at least a 56% critical chance. This can be stacked with  Corrupt Charge, granting a minimum combo multiplier of 4.0x and 88% critical chance, but reducing the combo time. This strategy may be more efficient if a combo duration mod is used (e.g.,  Body Count) to offset the effects of Corrupt Charge.

Trivia
Prior to Update 26.0 (2019-10-31), this is the second melee weapon to have a boosted channeling damage base of 1.8x, only coming after  Furax Wraith.
